author: medanasknan
name: halftone-shader
description: Animated WebGL shader background in the Halftone style. Generated by the 21st.dev Shader Builder. 4-color palette (#231A10, #A47148, #E3B587, #F9F1E7). Features: cursor-reactive (ripple). A drop-in, zero-dependency React component for hero sections and animated gradient/noise backgrounds.
